peak_hours_beijing: Monday–Friday excluding Chinese statutory public holidays, 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00; all other times off-peak
planned_four_hour_after_review: 19:28以后属于空闲时段；实际调度时间变化应重新计算，但按高峰全未命中预留可作保守上界
conservative_cost_formula: sum_i((input_tokens_i * 2 + max_output_tokens_i * 8) / 1e6), cache assumed miss; pending/unknown reservations remain in the same continuous ledger
actual_billing_formula: (cache_hit_tokens*p_hit + cache_miss_tokens*p_miss + output_tokens*p_output)/1e6 at actual tariff; not invoice total
seed: Current official Chat Completions API request schema contains no seed field. A complete HTML snapshot was fetched; literal word seed count=0. This is no documentation of support, not a proof that every undeclared parameter is rejected.
reasoning_effort: default high; none disables; low/high/max supported; compatibility minimal→low, medium/xhigh→high
temperature: Has no effect in thinking mode
top_p: Thinking effective 0.95–1.0; values below0.95 clipped; non-thinking fixed1.0 and supplied value ignored
max_tokens: Input+generated total must fit context; if unset default nonthinking8K, thinking64K, max effort128K. A default maximum must not be treated as a per-task budget.
